referee_caveats_inferred: Only one genuinely starless detection, so agreement with a predicted 2+/-1 has little discriminating power against the BE-sphere or other models
Detections are called starless by absence of catalog counterparts; low-luminosity or very young embedded sources could be missed
Predicted counts hinge on a single 0.4 Msun simulation set and an assumed 5 sigma criterion and on n_Limit chosen by the authors
Chamaeleon I, Ophiuchus and Orion datasets differ (different surveys, tracers, assumed temperatures), so virial comparisons are partly heterogeneous
Assumed constant T = 10 K and kappa = 0.23 cm^2/g give systematic mass errors of factors of a few
